name: Joahaz (son of Jehu)
title: The Suffering King of Israel
summary: Joahaz was king over the northern kingdom of Israel and the son of Jehu. His reign was marked by military weakness and oppression from the Arameans, but when he humbled himself and sought the Lord, God sent a deliverer to Israel. He reigned for 17 years in Samaria.

keyEvents.title: Joahaz Becomes King of Israel
keyEvents.description: Joahaz succeeded his father Jehu as king over Israel and reigned for 17 years in Samaria.

keyEvents.title: Continued in the Sins of Jeroboam
keyEvents.description: Joahaz did what was evil in the Lord's sight, following the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, which caused Israel to sin.

keyEvents.title: The Lord's Anger and Aramean Oppression
keyEvents.description: The Lord's anger burned against Israel, and he gave them into the hand of Hazael and Ben-Hadad throughout the reign of Jehoahaz.

keyEvents.title: Jehoahaz Prays to the Lord
keyEvents.description: In his distress, Jehoahaz pleaded with the Lord, and the Lord heard him because he saw how the king of Aram was oppressing Israel.

keyEvents.title: The Lord Sends a Deliverer
keyEvents.description: The Lord gave Israel a deliverer so that they were freed from the hand of the Arameans and could live in their homes as before.

keyEvents.title: Israel's Weakened Army
keyEvents.description: Jehoahaz was left with only 50 horsemen, 10 chariots, and 10,000 foot soldiers because the king of Aram had destroyed them.
